_doc: The 12 Autopilot & ADHD rules (CLAUDE.md, Nader 2026-10-11; requirements work/sdlc/requirements/REQ-1011-autopilot.md) mapped to the suites that enforce each. status is enforced or NOT ENFORCED (a rule whose test is a stub or a half; the summary prints AUTOPILOT RULES: n enforced, m NOT ENFORCED (list) and never hides it). Rules 4 and 5 are enforced since REQ-P2-1..3 (2026-10-12): the cap half of test-draft-and-cap and test-interrupted-and-keep run real code in plain Node. Every suite id must be a row in test-manifest.json (test-pipeline-manifest checks it).

rules.title: Nothing hidden is lost (control budget, 2-click reach)
Capture before classify (note capture, Alt chords, AltGr)
Nothing the tester typed or recorded is lost (draft survives, cap admits tester events)
Interrupted work is shown, not hidden (crash card, kept sessions)
State is always visible (badge, page indicator, timers)
The finish is one press and above the fold
The copied report is already a bug report
Short (word budgets on the rendered DOM)
One name per thing (EN and AR change together, banned terms)
Automation never widens capture or egress and never removes the human gate
